items.title: Grover Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, February 13, 1996
items.q: Joe was a very, very big part of the comeback of this band... Joe was a huge, huge factor in the resurgence of this band.

ctx.x: Okay. Fair enough. My goodness. And Joe comes together with the band a few times a year, right?

You notice how natural it is when he does come in? Oh, no, no, no, Joe was a very, very big part of the comeback of this band. You know the big band business had really frittered down pretty well in the 50s, and Joe was a huge, huge factor in the resurgence of this band. I would be remiss to tell you differently. And the old man never forgot that and he was always very, you know, appreciative of the fact of how important Joe was to that stage of the career. And Joe is another genius-level vocalist. You can’t lose…
I almost heard that in the “Here’s To Life” tonight.
